potato_early.description: Fungal disease caused by Alternaria solani, characterized by concentric rings on leaves
solutions: Remove and destroy infected leaves immediately
Avoid overhead watering and ensure good air circulation
Practice crop rotation - do not plant potatoes in same field for 2-3 years
potato_early.frequency: Every 7-10 days starting from first symptom
potato_early.prevention: Use disease-free seed potatoes, mulch soil to prevent spore splash

potato_late.description: Oomycete pathogen (Phytophthora infestans), causes water-soaked spots and rapid plant death
solutions: Remove affected plants and burn them - do not compost
Ensure proper drainage to reduce humidity
Space plants adequately for air circulation
potato_late.prevention: Use resistant varieties, avoid overhead irrigation, proper field sanitation

potato_healthy.description: Plant shows no signs of disease or pest damage
potato_healthy.prevention: Regular scouting, good agronomic practices, crop rotation

tomato_early.description: Fungal disease (Alternaria tomatophila) on lower leaves, causes target-like lesions
solutions: Prune lower leaves (20-30cm from ground) to improve air flow
Use drip irrigation instead of overhead spray
Apply mulch to prevent soil splash
tomato_early.frequency: Every 7-10 days starting from first symptom
tomato_early.prevention: Space plants properly, remove lower leaves, water at soil level only

tomato_late.description: Oomycete pathogen (Phytophthora infestans), causes water-soaked lesions on stems and fruits
solutions: Remove all infected plant parts and destroy them
tomato_late.frequency: Every 5-7 days when conditions favor disease
tomato_late.prevention: Use resistant varieties, proper spacing, avoid leaf wetness

tomato_healthy.description: Plant appears healthy with no visible disease symptoms
solutions: Remove excess lateral branches for better fruit production
tomato_healthy.prevention: Regular inspection, good pruning practices, proper nutrition
